description: Create a tweet draft. Before calling, fetch get_me + get_brand_voice (+ get_ai_context/get_recent_notes) AND call get_x_accounts for the posting account's max_tweet_length — never assume 280, since Premium/verified accounts go up to 25,000. If max_tweet_length is null the limit is unknown: ask the user rather than defaulting to 280. Site scope is automatic for a single-site account; pass domain or site_id to target one, and an account with several sites is asked to choose rather than guessed at. Requires text or thread. To attach an image, upload with upload_media then call attach_media_to_tweet with the asset_id and this tweet's id. Links to user-owned domains get UTM parameters appended at draft time so the traffic shows up in GA4 instead of as Direct; pass your own if you want explicit campaign slugs. When the tweet distributes a known blog post, pass its post_id (UUID, from get_posts) so the /admin/posts Distribution column links the two automatically — no manual backfill.

account_id.description: Id of the connected X account to post from. Alternative to account_username.

account_username.description: Username of the connected X account to post from, without @. Alternative to account_id.

description.description: Internal note about the draft in BlackOps. Not posted.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

post_id.description: UUID of the blog post this tweet distributes (from get_posts), so the two are linked.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

text.description: Tweet text for a single tweet. Pass text or thread, not both.

thread.description: A thread, in order: [{ text }, ...]. Pass text or thread, not both.

text.description: Text of this tweet in the thread.

title.description: Internal title for the draft in BlackOps. Defaults to the start of the first tweet.
